meta.title: The Purse on the Bus
meta.textType: story: a lost purse on the town bus

paragraphs: On Saturday, April twenty-fourth, Mom took Lily and Mia to the park on bus twelve. The concert in the park started at three o'clock. At twenty to three, the bus stopped at the market. A woman in a gray jacket got up and took her luggage from the rack. She hurried out of the bus with her phone in her hand. Lily looked down and saw a small red purse under the woman's seat. She picked it up. "Mom, look!" said Lily. Nobody else on the bus saw it. Mom told the driver that a woman left her purse. The driver looked in the big mirror. "I turn the bus at the park," he said, "and then I drive back past the market." "She will be upset," said Mia. "Can we contact her?" Lily opened the purse and looked inside. "There is no name or number," she said, "only a bus card and some coins." "The concert may start without us," Mom told the girls. "We may be late, but let's help anyway," said Lily. Mom smiled. The bus drove on to the park, and the other passengers got off. Then the driver turned the bus and drove back to the market.

At the market stop, a woman stood under a small roof. She wore a gray jacket, and her hands were tight together. She looked down the road and said nothing. The bus stopped in front of her, and the door opened.

Lily stood up and held out the purse. "Is this yours?" she asked. The woman looked at the purse and then at Lily. Lily gave back the purse to the woman. The woman received it with both hands. "I am so lucky that you were on this bus," she said. She put her hands together and bowed three times. The driver smiled from his seat.

"I remembered my purse at the shop door," said the woman. "The sign at the stop says that bus twelve comes back every twenty minutes." "I was very worried, but I waited here." "All my money is in it." Lily sat down again, and she did not say anything.

The bus reached the park at ten past three. From the gate, the three heard a trumpet and drums. "That is not the first song," said Mia. "We missed it." Lily looked at her empty hands. "I don't mind," said Mia. "Every person forgets something." Mom put one hand on each girl's shoulder, and they walked through the gate.
text.summary: On the town bus, Lily finds a red purse under a seat after a woman gets off. The driver turns the bus at the park, and the girls give the purse back at the market stop, so they reach the concert late.
